canonical_title: Short takeoff longitudinal acceleration and flight path response
subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.title_at_revision: Short takeoff longitudinal acceleration and flight path response
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's longitudinal acceleration during the STO is no less than 0.065g. The minimum longitudinal acceleration exists with no CG sink for shorebased STO, and with no more than 10 ft CG sink from CG position at deck edge for shipboard STO and no more than 10 ft CG sink from CG position at end of ramp for shipboard ski jump STO. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all STO tasks to evaluate air vehicle capabilities, including longitudinal acceleration for different STO flight path captures, for all required STO loadings and configurations, to include: a. Shorebased STO. b. Shorebased Ski-Jump STO. c. Shipboard Flat-Deck STO. d. Shipboard Ski-Jump STO. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Shorebased STO. b. Shorebased Ski-Jump STO. c. Shipboard Flat-Deck STO. d. Shipboard Ski-Jump STO. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Shorebased STO. b. Shorebased Ski-Jump STO. c. Shipboard Flat-Deck STO. d. Shipboard Ski-Jump STO.
